newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade thin at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade thin at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, near standstill late, USDA said.

Limited test slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,600 slaughter steers and 1,000 heifers; 24,700 head confirmed for the week to date including 19,200 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb holsteins 57.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00.
Wk to Date - 24,700 Week Ago - 66,300 Year Ago - 19,100
